title: All-hands March 2026 - talking points + Q&A draft
content:
Top-line: short, conversational. Goal: reassure about infra investments, surface wins, set expectations on Dedicated/private timelines.

Talking points (approx 12min):
- Quick welcome, kudos to eng + SRE for the last two outages mitigation work - call out Kai, Asha, and SRE on-call.
- Product highlights: Redwood Dedicated GA progress; early customers seeing 2-3x throughput improvement on 4k token loads.
- Hosting: hosted API latency improvements - p50 down 15% M/M; p95 down 10% (need final numbers from observability dashboard, TODO @Lucas).
- Private deployments: first pilot successful (BankCorp). Pilot learnings: KMS integration latency, onboarding docs need clearer step for network egress rules.
- Optimize toolkit: batching suggestions shipped; initial customers report 8-12% cost reduction.
- Roadmap bullets (high level): improve autoscaling policies, rollout model variants for fallback, expand EU region capacity.

Q&A prep (likely questions + short answers / notes):
Q: "Any ETA for Dedicated SLA?"
A: Short: working toward SLA for Q3 - depends on capacity commits; long: need Sales + Infra sync; action: Priya to confirm enterprise sales roadmap and customer pilot schedule.

Q: "What happened with last week's elevated tail latency?"
A: Root cause: delayed KV cache eviction + a hot-spot on one of the kernel variants; mitigation: auto-fallback to compatible variant and updated eviction thresholds. RCA doc (link) - TODO attach.

Q: "How are we handling model cost visibility for teams?"
A: Console now has token-level breakdown per route; working on per-prompt aggregation. UX follow-up: add sample queries and billing examples. Owner: Product (Lucas).

Notes to self / speaker cues:
- Start with brief human story (customer quote from BankCorp) - makes the infra talk feel tangible.
- Keep technical detail light; invite follow-up deep-dive for product/eng breakout.
- Time checks: aim for 10-12 mins talk; leave 8-10 mins for live Q&A.

Unresolved/needs before finalizing:
- Final latency/cost metrics (from observability): @Lucas
- Confirm Dedicated GA customers list and permission to name them: @Priya
- Attach RCA link and minimal diag slides: @Asha

Draft outro: "Looking ahead - we will focus on predictability: predictable latency, predictable cost, predictable rollout. Expect a short blog + deep-dive doc after the all-hands."

Scratchy bits / phrases to consider removing:
- "production-first developer experience"
- overly product-y bullet about 'unified runtime' - keep only if time allows

- [ ] Share deck with execs by 2026-03-05 for last pass

References:

End of draft. Will iterate after metrics from observability and confirmation from sales.
